Netflix released two versions of the Black Mirror episode “Bête Noire,” leaving viewers questioning what they had seen. The episode explores the Mandela effect through a woman who is certain of the name of the restaurant where her boyfriend worked, until she realizes the world around her has changed.

Some viewers saw the restaurant named “Bernie’s,” while others saw “Barnie’s.” Netflix gave no warning that different versions were in circulation, prompting debate that mirrored the episode’s premise. Both groups were right: there is no single “correct” answer.
